section_scheme.upper_boundary: Existing actual phaseA elbow/stifle separating domain, not a new height classifier

coronet_basis.source_pixels: Native side/quarter show a low flared hoof and a short taper between hoof top and reconstructed fetlock. Texture white stocking boundary is NOT used as a coronet.
coronet_basis.section_evidence: Host saved sections y.08 have broader forefoot span.1726x.2064m than y.16 span.1397x.1323m; hind .1974x.2308m at.08 versus .1340x.1715m at.16. Candidate y.10 lies in the distal flare below fetlock.
coronet_basis.anatomy_basis: Actually viewed Cuyer1905 Fig75 external forelimb and Fig86 external hindlimb place a distinct sloping pastern above the hoof capsule. Figures are drawings, not metric data. Konik photo confirms separable hoof wall/pastern but is not a period Chicago or breed/scale attestation.
coronet_basis.limitations: Model anatomy is stylized and texture-coronet/section agreement unproved. y.10 is one explicit reconstructed cut, NOT an attested anatomical measurement or photo-calibrated landmark. Actual contour/seed/protected/ground preflight may reject it.

profile.classification: New authored reconstructed short-walk profile, not donor measured/copy; motion remains unaccepted
profile.proximal_formula: theta_a = -nominal_angle_rad * existing_path_z/(original_stride*original_stance_fraction/2); exact original footpath drives phase; no clipping
profile.pastern_formula: theta_d = branch_amplitude_rad * 64*u^3*(1-u)^3; u=phase/.75 in stance, u=(phase-.75)/.25 in swing. Value/first/second derivatives zero at transitions.
profile.rationale: Small nonzero upper-link rotation tracks original fore/aft placement, while newly articulated carpus/hock supplies remaining reach. Pastern leans further forward under load (negativeX) and unloads toward upright/positiveX; conservative authored excursions redistribute articulation rather than shrink stride. No source states these exact values.
profile.uncertainty: All angles reconstructed, not measured normal ranges. Fore3/hind4 and pastern2–5degrees are one frozen candidate, not a fit/tuning search. Anatomy/contact/deformation and naturalness still need actual checks.
profile.source_motion_reference_not_used: Muybridge1878 Horse in Motion is gallop, not a walk; it is not cited for this timing or angle profile.
